content: Piinitɨarika
»Xɨka xewitɨ tuuru 'unawani yatɨni muxa, xɨka 'imieni yatɨni xɨka 'ituani, kutsiyarieya pɨyetuirieni yu'auxɨwime tewaxi tuuru munawakɨ, muxa hetsiemiemeta yunaukame muxatsi.
»Xɨka xewitɨ tinawanetɨ 'uxeiyarieni, xɨka 'umierieni, mɨkɨ hepaɨtsita 'atsipɨkatitaniukieni.

»Xɨka mɨkɨ tinawayame 'umierieni hekɨta, mɨkɨ mími hetsie pɨrahɨiyani. »Tinawayame peuyewetse mɨtiyutuanikɨ tita mɨrenawa. Xɨka ka'iyemanani mɨtiyutuanikɨ, kanituiyamɨkɨ ti'uximayatamekɨ mɨpaɨ mɨtiyutuanikɨ.
»Xɨka tewá hetaxeiyarieni 'akuxi hetsɨana 'ayenieretɨ, mɨkɨ piyetuani 'akuxi xeime tawarita heutinɨkame, tsepa tuuru yatɨni puxu yatɨni muxa.
»Xɨka xewitɨ yutewama tiwaminekaku xeime haraweritana meheutahaxɨani, mɨkɨ kawa'ɨwiyakaku xeime haraweritana mete'ukwani, tewakame pɨrayukatuani 'itsanari 'aixɨa mɨ'anenekɨ.
»Xɨka xewitɨ 'ɨxapa 'uta'ukwani, tɨriku xɨka hayetani yatɨni 'etsari mukuxeɨrietɨkari yatɨni hipame wa'etsaripa, kemɨ'ane mɨtiuyuri kepaɨmetɨ mɨtiutitai mɨkɨkɨ katinayukatɨamɨkɨ.

»Xɨka xewitɨ tumini xeime 'uhɨritɨani yu'iwa mi'ɨwiyanikɨ yatɨni tixaɨtɨ piinitɨarika, xɨka tinawayame tiunawani, mɨkɨ tinawayame pɨrayukatuani kepaɨ mɨtiunawa tawari hepaɨna paɨmeme, xɨkatsɨ 'uwiyarieni.
»Xɨka tinawayame 'uyuta'una, mɨkɨ mɨtihɨritɨariekai pɨyemie 'itsɨkame hetsɨa, naime mɨtitaxatɨanikɨ mɨkɨ 'atsimɨkatiuyurikɨ.

»Xɨka xewitɨ tixaɨtɨ tiuyukapiinitɨwani, meta xewitɨ mɨkɨtsiere, mɨkɨ meyuhutatɨ mepuhu 'itsɨkate wahetsɨa. Kemɨ'ane yakɨ mutaineni, mɨkɨ tawarita xeime pɨyetuani tita mɨtiuyukapiinitɨwakai, tuuru, puxu, muxa, kamixa tsepa tita mɨreuyehɨaka xɨka 'iwauka kename tipiinieyatɨkai.
»Xɨka xewitɨ yuhamiku puxu, tuuru, muxa 'uhɨritɨani yatsepa tita tewatsiekame, xɨka tewaya 'umɨni, tiutakwine, yatɨni xɨka 'unawarieni xewitɨ ka'uniere,
tewakame hamikuya Yawé hɨxie puyutaxata kename yutewa ka'ayeitɨa. Kutsiyarieya yuri ketita'eririeni, meta hamikuya pɨkatiyutuani.
»Xɨka hamikuya 'unieretɨtɨ munawarietsie, mɨpaɨ hɨrixɨa pɨrayukatuani.
»Xɨka tewatsiekame 'ɨrawe 'itakwani, hamikuya pɨkarayukatuani xɨka 'umeteya 'ixeiyatsitɨani.
»Xewitɨ xɨka yuhamiku tewa 'utaniɨwirieni, xɨka mɨkɨ rekwine yatɨni xɨka hemɨni, kutsiyarieya kanierekaku, kemɨ'ane mitaniɨ katinayukatuamɨkɨ.
»Xɨka kutsiyarieya nierekaku tiɨyɨni, mitaniɨ pɨkatiyutuani. »Xɨka tuminikɨ 'itaniɨkaitɨni mɨkɨkɨ xeikɨa pɨrayukatuani.
Kemɨreuyewetse hipame watsata 'uyeikatɨ
»Xewitɨ 'uki xɨka 'ɨimari 'utixɨatɨatɨyani 'uki kamaikame, xɨka hamatɨana 'ukahuni, wapaapama katiniwapitɨamɨkɨ kemɨraye'axe, meta kanitiwitɨmɨkɨ.
'Ɨimari paapaya xɨka ka'itaunieka menuwitɨnikɨ, 'uki pɨrayukatuani 'ɨimari mɨkamayɨiya kemɨraye'axe.
»'Uka 'ikewarikɨ mɨtiyɨ'ɨkitɨa pepɨwatakukuyani.
»Yunaitɨ teɨteri tewaxi memɨwakumaɨwa mɨkɨ meketakwikwiwani.
»Kemɨ'ane mawari xeimepɨta kakaɨyari mɨwewirieni, Yawé pɨta 'uwewirienikeme, mɨkɨ ke'umierieni.
»'Axapepɨkatikuhɨaweni waɨriyarika pepɨkati'aitɨaka 'ateewa kiekame, kena'eriwani 'ekɨ meta 'ateɨterima teewatari xepɨhɨkɨtɨkai 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie.
»Pepɨkatiwa'aitɨaka kwinimieme wiuraxi meta nutuite,
xɨka 'ekɨ mɨpaɨ petiyurieneni meta 'ateɨterima, mɨkɨ parewiya xɨka menetsi'utawawirieni, yurikɨ ne nekanaineni nekaniwaranu'enimɨkɨ xɨka meha'aiwatɨkani:
waɨkawa nehaxɨakɨ nepɨxekwini xeme 'ixiparakɨ. Xe'ɨitama yuxaɨta mepuyuhayewa, xeniwema nutuite mepɨyuhayewa.
»Xɨka xewitɨ xeme, nehetsɨamieme hawerimɨ'ane tumini 'uniɨtɨani, teyuniniɨtɨwamete wahepaɨ xepɨkatewakɨhɨaweni meta 'anamakame xepɨkawawiyani.
»Xɨka xewitɨ yu'iwa 'ɨkarieya 'akahurieni, piyetuirieni taikai kakɨyɨriwekaku.
Mɨkɨ yu'ɨkari xeime xeikɨa mexeiyakɨ tawarita pɨkaheixeiya xeime hetsiena mahuni. Xɨka netsi'utawawirieni parewiya, ne nepiparewieni kemaineni, ne Kakaɨyari nemɨtinekanenimaya nemɨhɨkɨkɨ.
»'Axapepɨka'utaineni Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita, meta 'axapepɨkarenutahɨaweni teɨteri wahetsiemieme manuyeka.
»Pepɨkatihayewani peti'atɨwatɨ 'iku mawariyari meta winu mawariyari. »Xeniwema matɨari miemete nehetsɨa mekanimiemetetɨni.
»Meta tewaxi tuurutsixi meta muxatsi nehetsɨa mekanimiemetetɨni. 'Atahuta tukari yumaama matɨa puyeikani, 'atahairieka tukaritsie pepɨnetsiyetuirieni.
»Xeme neteɨterima xemɨpatsie xepɨhɨkɨtɨni. »Xepɨka'ikwa'ani wai 'ɨrawe 'ikwaixaya. Mɨkɨ tsɨikɨri xepɨwamikwani.
